#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent validation-3 probes: F1 shape and class locations through the real builder."""
import importlib.util, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

source = Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0, str(source / 'kc-dev-flow-2/scripts'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('seam', source / 'kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/test_dispatch_stage.py')
seam = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(seam)

def snapshot(case):
    g = lambda *a: case.git(case.state, *a)
    files = {str(p.relative_to(case.state)): p.read_bytes().hex() for p in sorted(case.state.rglob('*'))
             if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts}
    return dict(head=g('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), index=g('ls-files', '--stage'), files=files)

def run(name, prepare, stage='ideation', extra=(), expect_exit=1):
    case = seam.DispatchStageTests('test_identical_retry_reuses_only_at_adding_commit'); case.setUp()
    try:
        extra = prepare(case) or extra
        before = snapshot(case)
        marker_before = case.marker.exists()
        result = case.build(stage=stage, extra=(*extra, '--spacedock', case.spy), expected=None)
        after = snapshot(case)
        out = dict(probe=name, exit=result.returncode, stdout_empty=result.stdout == '',
                   stderr_first=(result.stderr.splitlines() or [''])[0][:220],
                   builder_called=case.marker.exists() and not marker_before,
                   state_preserved=before == after)
        out['pass'] = (out['exit'] == expect_exit and (expect_exit == 0 or
                       (out['stdout_empty'] and not out['builder_called'] and out['state_preserved']
                        and out['stderr_first'].startswith('dispatch_stage: dispatch not built;'))))
        return out
    finally:
        case.doCleanups()

def f1(case):  # validation-2 F1: staged-only edit, worktree restored to HEAD, identical retry
    case.build(); r = case.record(); committed = r.read_bytes()
    r.write_bytes(committed + b'\nstaged-only annotation\n'); case.git(case.state, 'add', '--', r)
    r.write_bytes(committed)
    case.marker.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def task_staged(case):  # staged-only edit to the task file, fresh dispatch
    t = case.entity.read_bytes(); case.entity.write_bytes(t + b'\nstaged note\n')
    case.git(case.state, 'add', '--', case.entity); case.entity.write_bytes(t)

def nested_unstaged(case):  # committed nested report edited but not staged
    p = case.folder / 'review' / 'note.md'; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True); p.write_text('v1\n')
    case.git(case.state, 'add', '--', p); case.git(case.state, 'commit', '-m', 'report')
    p.write_text('v2 unsaved work\n')

def advance_older_staged(case):  # advance with a staged edit to an older dispatch record
    case.build(); case.set_stage('implementation')
    r = case.record(); r.write_bytes(r.read_bytes() + b'\nedited\n'); case.git(case.state, 'add', '--', r)
    case.marker.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return ('--advance',)

def other_task_dirty(case):  # allowed: unrelated task's pending work must survive a clean dispatch
    other = case.state / 'other-task.md'; other.write_text('pending\n'); case.git(case.state, 'add', '--', other)
    other.write_text('pending, unstaged too\n')

results = [run('F1 staged-only committed record, identical retry', f1),
           run('task file staged-only edit, fresh', task_staged),
           run('nested report unstaged edit, fresh', nested_unstaged),
           run('older record staged edit, --advance', advance_older_staged, stage='implementation'),
           run('unrelated task dirty, clean scope (allowed)', other_task_dirty, expect_exit=0)]
# allowed route also must keep the other task's bytes; checked separately below
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if all(r['pass'] for r in results) else 1)
EOF

- name: test_learning.py
        run: python3 kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/test_learning.py

      - name: Checkout pinned Spacedock plugin root
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          repository: spacedock-dev/spacedock
          ref: 4d158a484ec73e184861067f8ed1e20087fdc26a # tag v0.27.2, pinned by commit
          persist-credentials: false
          path: .sd-plugin-root

      - name: Install pinned Spacedock
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="spacedock_${SPACEDOCK_VERSION#v}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/spacedock.tar.gz \
            "https://github.com/spacedock-dev/spacedock/releases/download/${SPACEDOCK_VERSION}/${asset}"
          echo "${SPACEDOCK_SHA256}  /tmp/spacedock.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf /tmp/spacedock.tar.gz -C /tmp
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
          install -m 0755 /tmp/spacedock "$HOME/.local/bin/spacedock"
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: test_dispatch_stage.py
        run: SPACEDOCK_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/spacedock" python3 kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/test_dispatch_stage.py

      - name: test_sd_dispatch.py
        run: python3 kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/test_sd_dispatch.py --sd-plugin-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.sd-plugin-root"

      - name: test_observer_recovery.py
        run: SPACEDOCK_BIN="$HOME/.local/bin/spacedock" python3 kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/test_observer_recovery.py

# 0026. Role calls are owed on counts read from task records, and a dated call clears them whatever it says

Date: 2026-10-20

## Status

Accepted

## Context

`role_triggers.py` owed a chief-engineer call on a `- Cycle N` line under `### Feedback Cycles` and cleared a call only when its question named `Cycle 3` or `Amendment N`.
